summary: BUG-177, BUG-178, BUG-181 expense entry panel bug fixes - ALL TESTS PASSED. Verified: (1) Notes field in add form + table column, (2) Item name read-only in edit mode, (3) Added By column in table.
critical_code_review_comments: All 3 bug fixes properly implemented with correct data-testid attributes
BUG-177: Notes field added to EMPTY_LINE, EntryLine component, table headers, and edit mode
BUG-178: Edit mode now shows item name as static text instead of ItemCombobox dropdown
BUG-181: Added By column added between Payment and Notes columns, showing employee name
Transform layer (expenseTransform.js) correctly handles notes field in toAPI.addExpenseEntry and toAPI.editExpenseEntry
seed_data_creation: Used existing transactions from date 2026-07-09 (5 transactions: Bread 103, Guest Refund, Lassi, Match Box, tip in tip)
